bio.text: Kellie Keenan is the Republican candidate for Rhode Island's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election; there was no primary in the district.
According to her campaign website, she attended Suffolk University, where she completed a specialized program for public health leaders, and served in AmeriCorps NCCC.

Her website says she began her career at a community health center and went on to work in public health operations, including clinical research and leadership roles in medical, behavioral health and dental care.
